'''The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game''' is a cooperative living card game in which players lead a fellowship through scenarios. The [[TCGMix]] playtest includes all three Revised Core adventures, playable individually or as part of the Mirkwood Paths campaign.<ref name="catalog" />
